items.title: Define quantities before calculating
items.subject: calculation
items.description: Fix units, domains, aggregation, precision and invalid-input behavior before implementation.
items.use_when: The target produces deterministic numeric results from declared inputs.
items.do_not_use_when: A stochastic estimate or qualitative judgment is being presented as exact arithmetic.

items.title: Weighted rate, not average of percentages
items.subject: calculation
items.description: Inspect a concrete aggregation answer and checks for zero denominators, partitioning and order.
items.use_when: An aggregate calculation mixes groups with different denominators.
items.do_not_use_when: Groups overlap, counts are uncertain, or an unweighted group-level mean is actually the approved estimand.
